WHAT: Rescan re-identifies the same photo with new Gemini prompt, bypassing cache
WHERE: app/page.tsx (handleRescan), app/api/identify/route.ts (force param)
HOW: When photo is loaded from search history (not fresh upload), imageFile is null. Rescan converts imagePreview (data URL) back to a Blob/File using fetch(dataURL).then(r=>r.blob()). Passes force=true to identify API which skips the imageHash lookup.
WHY: Rescan is used for debugging — you want Gemini to re-run with updated prompts without uploading a new photo. Without force=true, the SHA-256 hash matches and returns cached old results.
GOTCHA: Force=true still saves a new Search DB entry (doesn't update old one). Useful during prompt iteration loops.
